title: Happy, Horny, Hazy (F4F (Kitty Girl))
description: Three loops for my sweet listeners, deserving of reward, and in each I'll treat you the way you need this the most, through carefully chosen praise to help you feel safe, secure, and so very wonderfully seen. Until those other thoughts which I weave, of a happier, hornier, and hazier kind, cover and cloud over your willing mind. Good Girl. My Sweet Girl. You are doing so good. Let me take you, what I want from you, and fully experience all the tingles of pleasure my voice brings. You are so perfect. These words you've earned from me, even as every day you become better, make your life better. Feeling so good. My nose touching against your face, rubbing against it, as I nuzzle at my silly kitty, affection and attention just washing over you in wave after wave...
author: Mistress Shibby
